verdict.rationale: Adyen documents a first-party Reveal Card Details iOS SDK that lets cardholders see their own PAN, CVC and expiry date in the app, so the core reveal flow is a product capability. The pack has no documentation that this flow keeps the developer out of PCI scope or SAQ D. missing for 10: vendor documentation of PCI-scope reduction or SAQ D avoidance, a description of how the reveal is isolated (hosted component or ephemeral-key mechanics), web or Android coverage beyond iOS, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can show cardholders their own PAN and CVV without inheriting PCI scope — hosted components or ephemeral-key reveal flows the vendor documents as keeping me out of SAQ D

citations.quote: Allow your cardholders to see their card verification code (CVC), primary account number (PAN), and expiration date.
